title: Tamil Literary KnowledgeHub: Irandaam Thirumurai Corpus v1 and Tools
description: A provenance-preserving Tamil literary corpus release package and reusable processing tools for Irandaam Thirumurai, derived from Tamil Virtual Academy/TamilVU source pages. The release includes JSONL records, schema, corpus card, datasheet, checksums, audit reports, source URLs, and reuse instructions. Source text is attributed to Tamil Virtual Academy/TamilVU and may be subject to separate rights.
